result.topic_en: Riemann P-function (Q-function) expressions with exponents 1/4 ± α/2 etc. for minimal surfaces, a sketch of a polygon with branch points, and a small differential calculation with substitutions b = 1-y, a = 1-xy.
result.transcription:
$k = Q\begin{pmatrix} a & b & c & d \\ \frac14+\frac{\alpha}{2} & \frac14+\frac{\beta}{2} & \frac14+\frac{\gamma}{2} & \frac14+\frac{\delta}{2} \\ \frac14-\frac{\alpha}{2} & \frac14-\frac{\beta}{2} & \frac14-\frac{\gamma}{2} & \frac14-\frac{\delta}{2} \end{pmatrix} z$
$k = Q\begin{pmatrix} 0 & \infty & a & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & \frac14+\frac{\alpha}{2} & \frac14+\frac{\beta}{2} \\ \frac12 & \frac12 & \frac14-\frac{\alpha}{2} & \frac14-\frac{\beta}{2} \end{pmatrix} z$
$\frac{Q_0^0}{Q_0^{\frac12}} = \frac{Q_\infty^0 + Q_\infty^{\frac12}}{Q_\infty^0 - Q_\infty^{\frac12}}$
$(1-z)^{\frac12}[-\ldots-] \begin{pmatrix} 1 & k & \frac1k \\ +\beta [?] & \frac14+\frac{\alpha}{2} & \frac14+\frac{\alpha}{2} \\ -\beta [?] & \frac14-\frac{\alpha}{2} & \frac14-\frac{\alpha}{2} \end{pmatrix} z$
$\rho_1 + \sigma_1 x = p(ac - (b\alpha + a)x)\alpha^n$ [?]
[sketch: polygon with vertices labelled a, b, $\frac{1}{4}$ [?], 1, k, $\infty$]
[-...-] $b = 1-y$
$a = 1-xy$
$b(1+2a)\,da + (1-a)a\,db$
$-(b(1+2a)\,d(xy) + xy\,a\,db$
$(1+2a)\,d\log x + d\log y\,(1+2a) + a\,d\log b$
